name: Pearls of Foam
source:
Sophie is a quiet and sweet woman who has struggles with her own lack of self confidence.

Her friends Judy and Sam, plan a trip to cheer her up from her recent break-up.

[From [url=https://maricore.itch.io/pearls-of-foam]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
索菲是一位安静温柔的女性，却长期受困于缺乏自信的烦恼。

为了帮刚刚经历失恋的她重拾好心情，好友朱迪与萨姆精心策划了一场旅行。

[摘自[url=https://maricore.itch.io/pearls-of-foam]itch.io[/url]]
